Annual Leave should be planned in advance and requested at least 5 working days before the intended start date wherever possible, so managers can plan for coverage. Annual Leave can be taken in blocks of one or more working days. Sick Leave: Every employee is entitled to 10 Sick Leave days per calendar year.
